Maria Ramos: Heads up — ACME (deal ACME-408) just sent their security pack: CAIQ + SOC2 + custom questionnaire. Uploaded to /files/ACME-security.zip and Google Drive https://go.redwood/ACME-security. They need answers by EOD Wednesday for procurement review. Can security pick this up?

TriageBot: Ticket created: RISK-3421 and added to #security-queue. Assigned to unclaimed.

Ethan Cole: I can take CAIQ + SOC2. Quick Q: is customer asking for in-scope data export access or API-level logs? Any specific infra details required?

Maria Ramos: Yes — they asked about data residency + encryption at rest (KMS) usage. Also several app-level controls where they want 3rd-party access clarified.

Priya Shah: I can handle app-control questions. For KMS details I'll need a config snippet from Eng-Infra. @Ben can you paste the key info?

Ben Kim: Not on hand, sending minimal snippet: `kms_provider: aws` `key_alias: redwood-prod-app-1` `region: us-west-2`. Full config in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infra/kms.

Ethan Cole: Thanks. Plan: I'll do CAIQ->owner mapping. Priya does app controls. Legal Ops @Sarah Patel for data residency and contract clauses. ETA for CAIQ: 48 hours. Prioritize 'data access' and 'third-party access' sections.

Sarah Patel: Looping in. If they need contract language changes we'll need PO + 1 week minimum, but we can propose standard language in the interim.

Maria Ramos: Procurement is pushing timeline hard. Can we return redlines for the 6 critical questions this week only? If yes I'll escalate on my side.

Ethan Cole: Yes. I'll mark priority items. Quick mapping:
```
CAIQ -> owners:
- A.1 Encryption at rest -> Eng-Infra (Ben Kim)
- A.2 KMS rotation -> Eng-Infra (Ben Kim)
- B.3 Access control -> Solutions Eng (Priya Shah)
- C.4 Data residency -> Legal Ops (Sarah Patel) + Security (Ethan Cole)
```
I'll attach draft answers as separate doc in the ticket.

Maria Ramos: :thumbsup: Please add estimated time per section. Also need a single POC for the customer — I'll be that contact (maria@acme.com).

Priya Shah: I'll prep draft answers for access control by EOD tomorrow.

Ethan Cole: Assigning thread -> `security-queue` and linking RISK-3421. I'll update status here when CAIQ draft uploaded. :eyes:

Maria Ramos: Thanks all — will let the customer know we have a plan. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
